content:
The HWPX document generation failed because the required severity string 'High (즉시조치)' was missing from the XML output.
The test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, the verifier expected the combined content of section0.xml and section1.xml to contain the formatted string 'High (즉시조치)', but it was not found in the generated HWPML section tags. While 3 tests passed, the failure indicates a mismatch between the JSON summary data and the actual text rendered in the HWPX section files.
